full_chain_regeneration.note: All four generators re-run in order at the frozen candidate produced a byte-identical tree. This is the FIRST wave in which the documented recipe actually covers every producing generator (PPRCHK-198-02).

classify_and_packet_determinism.previously: read live HEAD, so the generated bytes changed with whatever commit was checked out and the committed bytes could never be reproduced

refreeze_idempotency.note: the driver reads the reviewed matrix from git, never from its own output, so re-running reproduces the same corrected bytes instead of failing on them

determinism_properties: no environment variable participates in any generated authority-bearing value
path_sensitivity: Regenerating at a DIFFERENT filesystem path changes exactly the explicitly-declared, launcher-verified path bindings and nothing else.
